messages.content: How long have you been living with diabetes, sir?
Oh, it's been about thirty five years now.
How long have you been taking insulin for this?
Well, um, I've been taking insulin for about twenty years now.
Do you have any major medical conditions that I should know about?
Yeah, um, prostate cancer.
How were you treated for this?
How can I help you today?
I've been having really bad headaches lately.
Have you had any blurry vision or light sensitivity?
Yes, I've had blurry vision.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting with it?
Yes, some nausea.
Have you had any weakness or numbness anywhere?
No, neither.
Have you had any trouble with your speech or balance?
What brings you in to the clinic today?
Well, I have had a progressive loss of my vision in my right eye. My eye doctor told me that I should come and see a neurologist. So here I am.
How long has the vision loss been progressing for?
About two months. It seems like it has been progressing really fast. I have always had bad vision in my left eye. That started about two years ago.
Can you still see out of you left eye?
No. I am considered blind in this eye now.
Have you had any other symptoms associated with your vision loss?
No.
Any headaches?
Nope.
Which hand is your dominant hand?
What do you mean?
What hand do you write with or use dominantly?
Oh! I am right handed.
And how old are you?
How can I help you today?
My lower back has been hurting since I lifted something heavy.
Have you had any swelling or redness in the area?
No, neither.
Have you had any fever or chills?
So what seems to be the problem today?
I've been having really bad headaches lately.
On a scale of one to ten, how severe is it?
It's a nine, it's pretty bad.
Are you currently taking any medications?
Do you live alone?
I do. I lost my husband to prostate cancer last year.
How have you been doing otherwise?
Not bad. I've been keeping myself busy with gardening.
And as your doctor I have to ask, but any history of alcohol or drug use?
Were there any other complications with the pregnancy?
He was exposed to drugs in the womb while I was pregnant, and he has been diagnosed with autism.
he has previously had an operation on the right knee, can you tell me more about that?
He previously had a lot of trouble straightening out both of his legs, and since the right was worse than the left he had an operation on the inside part of the back of that leg.
When was this operation?
It was in February of two thousand seven.
How did he respond to the operation?
He responded really well, he was walking much better, and even got back to playing sports with the other kids in the neighborhood.
What seems to be the problem today?
Do you smoke cigarettes?
Yes.
Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
Yes, I have been in and out of treatment. I am not doing so well with staying clean.
What substances do you use?
What is your current living status?
Well, right now I am living with my sister in Sacaton. I am currently looking for my own place, but I am staying with her for now.
Are you looking for a place in Sacaton?
No. I will probably look for a place back in Coolidge.
Back in Coolidge?
I recently separated from my wife. We lived in Coolidge together. Sacaton is too far away from everything, but it is fine for now.
Are you and your sister close?
Not when we were growing up but now that we are older, we have become very close. She has been a great support for me in these hard times.
Are you a tobacco user?
I smoke cigarettes. I only smoke a little bit.
How much do you smoke per day?
I only smoke about one or two cigarettes a day.
Do you or have you ever used drugs or alcohol?
I have never used drugs. I used to be a heavy drinker. I quit drinking a year ago.
Do you attend A A meetings?
Can you tell me more about your daughter's injury?
Well, we came in in November, and she was diagnosed with an acute on chronic right slipped capital femoral epiphysis.
Did she have surgery on this?
Yes, let me look at my notes, I have it written down here, um, a situ pinning.
Remind me, how old are you, dear?
Do you have any children, ma'am?
Yes, I have a wonderful baby girl at home.
were there any complications with your pregnancy or delivery?
Nope, everything went very smooth. I'm thankful.
have you ever been hospitalized for any issue?
No, thankfully.
so I can assume you've never had surgery?
How is your sleep?
Yes, without any disturbance. I sleep like a log!
Any mood swings or did you feel your emotions are out of control?
Nah, just the normal mood swings around my periods otherwise no problem at all.
Have you had any feelings of depression or sudden mood changes?
No, neither.
Have you had any sadness or hopelessness?
Hi, how are you?
I am okay.
Do you have any bone pain or issues around that?
No, I do not.
How well is your pain controlled?
Let's get started, how old are you?
Good afternoon, doctor. I'm fifty two years old.
My nurse says that you're here for an independent evaluation, is that correct?
Yes sir, that is.
what do you do for a living?
Right now, I'm a temporary employee for A B C A B C, I've worked for A B C D, too.
What do you do there?
Mainly, I handle the loading and unloading of furniture and appliances for people's houses.
When did you get hurt?
It was about two and a half weeks ago now, back in October.
Do you have a history of back problems, like before this injury?
Yeah, I've had back pain for a long time.
What happened when you got hurt this time?
I was unloading one of the A B C eighteen wheelers, when I bent down to pick up some boxes, and I felt the pain.
What kind of pain did you feel?
I felt a sharp pain in my lower back right away when I tried to lift those boxes.
Does your pain go down your legs?
Yes, it goes into the right side of my butt, and then all the way down the outside of my right leg, like into the knee.
How have your symptoms progressed since they began?
Doctor, they've only gotten worse.
Do you have any pain in your left leg?
A little, not as bad as the right.
What other symptoms are you having besides the pain down your leg?
The muscles in my butt are spazzing, and it's happening more and more.
Have you seen another doctor for this?
Yes, I saw Doctor Z at first.
What did they do for you?
He gave me some muscle relaxers, and some, um, Lidocaine patches.
Did this help at all?
No, not at all.
Who else have you seen?
I saw doctor X Y Z too, through worker's comp.
When did you see them?
That was back in April.
What did they recommend?
Um, he sent me for an M R I, and I have the report for that right here.
Did he give you any medications?
Yes, he gave me some opioids.
What is your work status right now?
Doctor X Y Z put me on restricted duty status, doctor.
When you went for follow up, did you still have that pain down your legs?
Yes, I did.
What did doctor X Y Z recommend at that time?
He referred me to a Pain Clinic, and he recommended I have, um, epidural injections with doctor A B C.
Did you have this done?
Yes, I did. No, it did absolutely nothing.
so after that, what treatment did you have?
I had an M R I, um, E M G, and nerve conduction study with doctor A B C D.
Do you have the results of that as well?
Yes, doctor, they're right here.
What aggravates your pain?
Well, anything like sitting for a long time. When I do that, I feel it in my legs.
When you sit for a long time, is it in both legs?
It's really on my right.
Are you able to sleep at night?
No, sir, I'm not able to sleep at all.
Have you been able to return to work?
Well, I went back to work in June, after doctor X said I'd reached the maximum medical improvement we talked about.
Finally, have you seen a chiropractor for this pain?
Yeah, I saw doctor X about eight or nine times.
Did they do anything to help you feel better?
Hi, do you smoke?
No, sir, I don't.
Do you use any recreational or illicit drugs?
No.
What about drinks?
How old is the baby?

She is just fourteen days old. Let me tell you from the beginning. On Friday, when I was taking her for a bath, I noticed a blister near her umbilicus area. We went to our doctor on Saturday, and they did a test.
Did you get the test result?
I got it today. Here is the report.
So how is the blister on the umbilicus now?

She has been doing good. We put on some bacitracin ointment, and it almost healed up. But today I noticed that another small blister on her head. It really scared me, and I did not want to take any chance. That's why I reached out to the Infectious Disease center. I know it is private. But still, I don't want to take any chance with my baby's health. I called the center directly and they asked me to come to the hospital.
How are her eating and sleeping habits?
She hasn't missed any of her meals. She is taking around two ounces of milk in every feed. I don't think I have any issues with her eating or sleeping.
Did she have any fever?
Not that I noticed.
Has she been lethargic or crying more than normal?
No.
Have you noticed any other changes in her daily routine?
What brings you in today?
I have this nasty cough and my nose has been super stuffy.
Are you bringing anything up when you cough?
Not really, no.
Are you having any other symptoms, such as chest pain or headaches?
No, neither.
Are you having any other symptoms, such as nausea or vomiting?
No. I did have a slight headache last night but I took Advil and it's since gotten better.
Are you taking anything for the cough or stuffy nose?
What's going on today?
I've had this cough that won't go away for two weeks.
Have you had any fever or chills?
Yes, I've had a low fever.
Have you had any shortness of breath or wheezing?
No, neither.
Have you had any sore throat or congestion?
Hi there how are you?
I am good no problem at all other than the usual.
And what is that?
You know, some discomfort I have on my right side. I have been feeling that since I had a stroke five years back.
We did an E M G right?
Yes.
And none of the medications we tried are helping?
No, I also saw a neurologist, but nothing is helping
and are you monitoring your sugar regularly?
Oh yes, Everyday at least two to three times a day.
And how bout insulin dose?
Oh, that I kind of adjust myself.
And you are not smoking or drinking again are you?
Do you remember when your last flu vaccine was?
I don't remember what month, but it was in nineteen ninety nine.
and do you remember your last pneumonia vaccine?
Let me look at my notes here, um, it was in nineteen ninety six.
Do you know their medical histories?
Let me think, my dad is still around, he had a stroke. Oh yeah, and he has high blood pressure.
How old is your father?
He's seventy nine now.
what about your mother?
She died when she was seventy four, she had heart failure and emphysema.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
How old are you?
I am forty four.
Are you right handed or left handed?
I'm right handed.
Was there any sensation like having pins and needles?
I was able to walk and there was no weakness or any other thing you mentioned.
When did you first start noticing these symptoms?

There was nothing around Independence Day. It all started after that. At first, I felt that my right hand is very clumsy, and it is kind of stiff. Then I noticed leaning towards the right when walking. It was strange. Happened around July seventh.
Did you recently have any cold or flu like symptoms?
No.
Were you diagnosed with a thing called multiple sclerosis?
No.
Did you ever have a feeling where you felt like there's an electric is going up or down your spine?
No.
How about any fatigue or pain?
If I'm understanding correctly, you sustained an elbow injury during a fight with some other kids in Juvenile Hall?
Yeah. My left elbow is killing me.
How old are you?
Seventeen.
Are you having pain anywhere else?
Yeah. My left ankle also hurts.
Are you able to walk without difficulty?
Yeah.
Any knee pain?
Not right now, but I've had left knee pain in the past.
Did you pass out or hurt your neck in any way?
I didn't pass out. I hit my head against the floor when one of the kids tried to pin me down.
Do you have a headache, nausea, or blurry vision?
No.
And no chest or abdominal pain?
No.
Were any weapons used during the fight?
What can I help you with today?
I've noticed I'm losing weight without trying.
Do you smoke or use any tobacco products?
No, I've never smoked.
Are you currently sexually active?
Are you a new patient?
I am. I've been traveling a lot, so I don't have a local doctor I usually see.
What is the reason for your visit?
I've had this dark spot on my leg for a long time.
Do you know if your family has any chronic medical problems?
Not that I know of.
Before I go over the procedures, have you had a surgery before?
You have been diagnosed with allergic rhinitis, right?
Um, I would say around four years now. Oh my God it has been so, so many medications that I had to take for this.
Are you diabetic?
No, I don't have any such conditions.
So no hypertension or any kidney diseases?
Nope.
Have you ever been diagnosed with tuberculosis, asthma, or another lung condition?
Has anyone in your family had heart diseases?
Yes my father. They did his heart bypass surgery when he was sixty.
Is he alright now?
Yes I know what you mean. Yes by God's grace, both my parents are alive.
What exactly was the heart disease named?
Yeah they said it was something called coronary artery disease and he had many strokes due to that.
How old is he now?
My father is in his eighties. My mother is eighty years old too and she has dementia. My father has dementia too.
Do you smoke or drink alcohol?
How are you feeling today?
I am feeling very tired.
Have you had any other self harm events that you have not come to see use for?
No. I have been seeing Doctor Lin.
Is there anything that is currently going on in your life that could be triggering these resent episode?
Last month I lost my job. And then this month my boyfriend left me.
Have you been diagnosed with any mental health conditions?
Doctor Lin just said that I was depressed.
Have you ever been put on any medication for the for your depression?
I have taken Lexapro before.
How long ago did you take the Lexapro?
Refresh my memory, please, how old are you, sir?
I'm forty nine.
Also, I need you to remind me, when was your lower back surgery?
It was in January of two thousand five. What was the name of the surgery, again?
So, how are you feeling today?
Truthfully doctor, the surgery did nothing. I'm still in a lot of pain.
Besides the surgery, what other interventions have you tried?
I have them written down, let me look. Um, I did acupuncture, T E N S unit at P T, and I've been to the chiropractor too.
Have you taken any medicines?
Yeah, I have those written down here. I've taken Elavil, Topamax, Cymbalta, Neurontin, and Lexapro.
Are you still taking any of these?
No, I had bad side effects to some, and the others just didn't do anything.
Have you had any injections for this pain?
I've had a few into the, um, piriformis.
Did that do anything?
Um, it provided some brief relief, I guess. I had a Botox procedure done on March eighth two thousand six.
How did this work?
Honestly, it did nothing.
Where is your pain, exactly?
I'd say its seventy five percent in my butt and leg, and twenty five percent in my lower back.
Are you able to workout, or exercise, anything like that?
I've tried to increase how much I walk, but when I do I get spasms in my lower back.
with ten being the worst pain of all time, how would you rate your pain today?
I'd say it's a six out of ten today.
What adjectives would you use to describe the pain?
Um, I'd say its shooting, sharp, and, um, aching.
Specifically, what activities make the pain worse?
Well, lifting, standing for a long time, or, um, squatting. I can't do that anymore.
Does anything make the pain better?
Um, sitting back, ice, and I guess there's some improvement with the pain medication.
Is the pain constant, or does it come and go?
It's constant now, but, um, the intensity of it comes and goes.
Are you able to sleep at night?
Not really, it is affecting my sleep, which in turn affects my mood.
How is the pain affecting you right now?
How old are you, sir?
I'm sixty five years old.
Are you right handed or left handed?
I'm right handed.
When was your last stroke?

Well, it was on January seventeenth. I had these episodes where I was like always so confused and looks like I lost everything. All my memory and everything. And then they did a scan. It was verified that I was having a stroke on the same day.
Did they put you on some medications?
They gave me an anticonvulsant and aspirin.
Are you taking them regularly?

There have a few times like one or two days that I forgot to take my, uh, dyphenhydramine, but even when I'm taking it regularly, I'm still having all those symptoms or forgetfulness, confusion, and everything.
Do you feel anything else along with these episodes like a urine urgency, tendency to bite your tongue, headaches, any visual change, or your heart is beating very fast?
No nothing else, just the confusion and forgetfulness.
How frequent are these episodes?
Hello, what brings you here today?
I fell four times on third of this month because my leg suddenly gave out.
How old are you?
You don't ask age of a lady. She will never tell you the truth.
So how old are you?
That's true. I'm just teasing you. I'm fifty one.
Are you right handed or left handed?
I am right handed.
What happened exactly?

Oh, I noticed weakness in my right leg before as well and sometimes, like, I have to give the support of my arm to actually move it. Sometimes during these episodes I just turn pale and it's like overall weakness. I feel so tired. My husband, he gives me some sugar, three teaspoons, and then it helps a little bit but not completely.
So, is your weakness like overall in your legs or it is at any single point?
It's overall. I remember in one of these episodes I was, like, in an odd fisted posture.
Is there any change in your sensations?
No, nothing like that.
Is there change in vision?
Nope.
Any difficulty in swallowing or eating?
Nope.
Any difficulty in speech?
No.
You said that these episodes have been happening for some time, so did you see anyone for those before?
Are you married?
I'm divorced.
So, do you live alone?
I live with my girlfriend, and we have a kid together. I also have three other kids from my former wife.
Do you smoke?
I used to smoke. But I, I've quit like fifteen years ago.
What about alcohol?
Yeah, I drink beer. Around one to two beers a day.
Are you working?
Do you or have you used tobacco products,sir?
No. I have never been a smoker.
Do you have any history of alcohol or recreational drugs use?
I have never been a drug user, but I used to drink a little, but it was never a problem. I don't drink any more.
What do you do for a living?
Do you have any nausea, vomiting?
Yes to both.
How about fever?
Yes, I do.
Any blood in sputum or chest pain?
Before we begin, can you confirm your age for me, please?
I'm fifty six years old.
What seems to be the problem today?
Well, I have a history of systemic lupus erythematosus.
How have you been treated for this in the past?
Um, I went to a rheumatologist about four months ago, I had discomfort in both of my hands.
Which hand was worse?
My left was worse than my right at that time.
Have you seen anyone else for this?
Um, I came in on October thirtieth two thousand seven. I was having the same problem.
What did they do for you at that time?
They have me a trial of Elavil because they thought it was, um, ulnar or radial neuropathy.
Did they give you any topical creams?
Yeah, they gave me a prescription for Zostrix but I couldn't fill it because of my insurance.
have your symptoms gotten worse since they began?
Yeah, especially here, at the base of my left hand, like around my wrist.
Which fingers do you feel it in?
Right here, doctor.
Do you have any other symptoms of note?
Um, actually yeah, I've been having some respiratory problems for the last three days or so.
What symptoms have you been experiencing?
Um, I've had a dry cough and I feel like I've had a fever but I haven't taken my temperature.
Have you had any night sweats or chills?
No, not that I can remember.
Have you had any chest pain or discomfort?
No.
Have you had any shortness of breath or gastrointestinal problems?
So what seems to be the problem today?
I get numbness and tingling in my hands sometimes.
Have you had any blurry vision or light sensitivity?
Yes, I've had blurry vision.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting with it?
Yes, some nausea.
Have you had any weakness or numbness anywhere?
Where are you having numbness?
In my left hand.
And no other symptoms?
No. Just that weird feeling in my left hand.
What about any phlegm or shortness of breath?
So, what is your family's living situation at home?
Um, he lives at home with me, and his father.
May I assume that you are his biological parents?
Yes, that's correct.
does he have any siblings?
No, right now, he's an only child.
What grade is he in?
He's in the third grade.
How is he doing in school?
Do you know about any medical traits in your family?
No, everyone in my family is quite healthy. I'm not aware of any medical problems.
Are you sexually active?
Yes, I am with my boyfriend.
Do you take any drugs or alcohol?
No, neither.
Do you take any smoke?
What's going on today?
I've been feeling dizzy whenever I stand up.
Do you drink alcohol?
So what seems to be the problem today?
I've had diarrhea for the past three days.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting?
No, neither.
Have you had any fever or chills?
What brings you in today?
I have a persistent sinus headache and pressure in my face.
Have you had any fever or chills?
Yes, I've had a low fever.
Have you had any shortness of breath or wheezing?
Yes, I've been a little wheezy.
Have you had any sore throat or congestion?
No, neither.
Have you noticed any chest pain when you cough?
You recently turned sixty seven, correct?
Yes. Sixty seven years young.
Are you right or left handed?
Right.
When were you first diagnosed with Parkinson's?
September first of nineteen ninety five.
Do you remember who diagnosed you?
A local doctor I was seeing at the time. A year before my diagnosis, I had a few falls and episodes of lightheadedness. I also noticed that I was staggering a lot more when walking.
Did you lose consciousness during any of your falls?

Not that I know of. I had noticed that I was losing my normal voice to a degree. On top of losing my normal voice, my handwriting became smaller and smaller. I don't ever remember writing so small. Something seemed really off to me.
By slower, do you mean the movements of your arms and legs were slower and impaired?
Yes. I was prescribed Sinemet back in September of nineteen ninety five.
Did you notice any improvement while taking it?
None. I was pretty disappointed and discouraged as a result. I have problems with coordination and walking without staggering even today.
Are you experiencing any other symptoms, such as stroke like events or vision changes?
No, neither.
Are you experiencing any other symptoms, such as stroke like seizures or problems with moving?
No, neither.
Are you experiencing any other symptoms, such as stroke like coordinating your arms?
No.
Any headache or nausea?
No, neither.
Any vomiting or chills?
No, neither.
Any fever?
Is it worse when you exert yourself?
Um no, not really. I've had a terrible cough along with frequent headaches and chest congestion. I have also had a low fever.
Did these symptoms start around the same time?
I think so.
Where does your chest feel most congested?
Both sides. I'd say it's at a three currently.
Does it send pain or numbness or tingling down your arms?
No, but it does get worse whenever I cough.
Is this your first time experiencing this type of congestion?
Oh no. I had something like it about ten months ago.
Did that improve on its own?
Where do you live?
I live with my mother around the corner where the Whole Foods is. I have been there for a few years now.
Are you the mother of the patient?
Yes, I'm the mother.
How are you dealing with everything?
How are you doing today?

I have a long history of lung disease. COPD to be exact. Recently, I was experiencing a lot of coughing and shortness of breath even on walking from one room to another. All the time I felt sleepy, tired, or confused.
How is it now?
It is getting better.
What else?

I was also diagnosed with pneumonia; I was on trip and there they found it. It is also getting a lot better now, but doctor said to continue taking oxygen for some more time. I also felt very instable and had a fall. I did not call for any assistance but now I think I should have called someone. Everyone including my family and nurses all tell me all the time to call for assistance. I was just being stubborn and hurt myself.
Did you use a wheelchair?
Where do you live?
I live in a board and care. It is a nice small care home with some very nice and supportive people. It is just next to the Safeway on Village Drive.
Did you consume alcohol in any way?
No Sir.
Any tobacco consumption?
Never in my life.
Did you ever try any kind of illicit drugs?
What brings you in today?
I've been short of breath just climbing the stairs.
Is this affecting your ability to work or do your daily activities?
Not really, I can still manage.
Does anyone in your family have a history of heart disease, diabetes, or cancer?
What do you do for a living, sir?
I'm actually retired, but I used to work as a dock hand.
Do you smoke?
I smoke about a half a pack of cigarettes a day.
Do you drink, sir?
What's going on today?
I've had diarrhea for the past three days.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting?
Yes, I've thrown up twice.
Have you had any fever or chills?
Yes, a mild fever.
Have you noticed any blood in your stool?
Hello, sir how can I help you?
Yeah, I need to get this loud and obnoxious snoring under control. I keep waking up my partner. I have a C P A P right now because I was told I have almost severe sleep apnea.
How has the device been working?

It definitely has reduced my snoring, but my partner keeps waking me up in the middle of the night because the mask pops off. I wear it around five to seven nights a week, but for some reason it falls off or I take it off randomly in the night. My wife usually must remind me to put it back on.
So what is your sleep pattern now?

Usually I sleep around eleven or eleven thirty and wake up at six or seven on the weekends. I'll sleep in until eight or nine on the weekdays. On Saturday's I might go to sleep around midnight because I usually watch a show with my family. I feel good when I wake up though. Much less tossing and turning. The sheets are always on the bed still.
How has work been?
How can I help you today?
I've had trouble breathing at night, it wakes me up.
Have you had any fever or chills?
No, neither.
Have you had any shortness of breath or wheezing?
Yes, I've been a little wheezy.
Have you had any sore throat or congestion?
No, neither.
Have you noticed any chest pain when you cough?
What brings you in today?
I get numbness and tingling in my hands sometimes.
Have you had any blurry vision or light sensitivity?
No, neither.
Have you had any nausea or vomiting with it?
What's going on today?
I've been short of breath just climbing the stairs.
Are you currently taking any medications?
No, nothing regularly.
Do you have any other ongoing medical conditions I should know about?
No, I'm generally pretty healthy.
How has your sleep been lately?
Are you from the area?
I was born and raised in Iowa. My husband and I moved here twenty years ago, and we have been here ever since.
Do you have kids?
Yes! We have two kids.
Do you have any history or present use of tobacco?
No, neither.
Do you have any alcohol or recreational drugs?
No, neither.
Do you have any substances?
How are you feeling today, ma'am?
Honestly, overall, I'm feeling a lot better.
Are you still having the diarrhea and decreased appetite?
Yes, but I'm still feeling better though.
Have you been peeing a normal amount?
Yeah, no problems there. I measured it like you told me to—six hundred M L.
When was the last time you peed?
Um, it was about seven this morning.
Are you having any fever symptoms?
Any history of smoking?
Uh yeah, but I quit in two thousand seven.
On average, how many packs per day did you smoke?
Uh if I were to guess, I'd say one pack per day.
Any other drugs?
I used to do coke, but I quit that in two thousand five.
And any history of drinking?
What's going on today?
I've had trouble breathing at night, it wakes me up.
Have your medications been helping?
Not really, the symptoms still come back.
Has it been getting better, worse, or staying about the same?
My nurses tell me that you're thirty nine years old, is that correct?
Good morning, Doctor. Yes, that's correct.
So, what seems to be the problem today, ma'am?
I hurt my knee while on the trampoline back in late August.
Do you remember the mechanism of injury to this knee?
What do you mean?
was it a twisting, pulling, snapping kind of injury?
Oh, I twisted my knee.
have you seen another doctor for this?
Yeah, and I got an M R I.
Can I see the report?
Yes, here you go.
Do you have any instability in this knee?
Yeah, I feel like my knee joint has been unstable for years.
Have there been any dislocations?
Do you want some time?
No, I am okay.
Did you have any chest pain or shortness of breath?
No, neither.
